verified: The consortium (EHU, Luxquanta, Ciena, GÉANT, PCSS, RedIRIS and SURF) says it demonstrated the network at SC26 with five nodes in three locations, QKD on the two short links, ML-KEM-based PQC on the long links, and QuLore coordinating keys across Luxquanta, EHU vKMS and SURF eduKMS systems.
unconfirmed: Key generation rates, latency, throughput under load, and any independent or peer-reviewed measurement of the setup; the press release also leaves out whether this becomes a production service and on what timeline.

verified: 主办方新闻稿称，SC26 期间在芝加哥、阿姆斯特丹与毕尔巴鄂/Zamudio 的五节点间搭建了 8000 公里混合网络，使用 Luxquanta Nova lq QKD、Ciena WL6e/WL5e 光层加密、QuLore 编排与 ML-KEM，三层加密在演示中同时运行。
unconfirmed: 密钥生成速率、QKD 与 PQC 切换时延、三层加密的实际吞吐等性能说法仅出自新闻稿，无第三方测量或同行评议细节；该架构何时进入生产网络、成本与运维要求也未说明。
